content:
Here’s a complete, idiomatic implementation for the `knr-ops` stack. All files follow ACK v1alpha1 CRD schemas, Kustomize overlay patterns, and Flux best practices.

### 📁 Directory Structure Additions
```text
infra/
  s3/
    logs.yaml
  iam/
    logs-irsa.yaml
overlays/
  dev/
    kustomization.yaml  ← (append resources & patches)
  prod/
    kustomization.yaml  ← (append resources & patches)
flux/
  kustomizations.yaml   ← (append new Kustomization CRDs)
```

---

### 1. Base S3 Bucket (`infra/s3/logs.yaml`)
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
    app.kubernetes.io/component: logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    # Environment-specific bucket name injected via overlay
    # versioning:
    #   - enabled: true
    # serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    #   - rule:
    #       applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
    #         sseAlgorithm: AES256
    # publicAccessBlock:
    #   - blockPublicAcls: true
    #     blockPublicPolicy: true
    #     ignorePublicAcls: true
    #     restrictPublicBuckets: true
```
> 💡 *Note: Base resources intentionally omit env-differentiated fields. Overlays patch `bucket`, `region`, and inject security configs to keep the base DRY.*

---

### 2. Base IAM Role + Policy (`infra/iam/logs-irsa.yaml`)
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-role
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
    app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[]}'
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-policy
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
    app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    policyDocument: '{}'
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1alpha1
kind: PolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-policy-attachment
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    policyArn: v1:iama::logs-irsa-policy
    roleName: v1:iam::logs-irsa-role
```

---

### 3. Dev Overlay Patches (`overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`)
*Append to existing `resources:` and add under `patches:`*
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../infra/s3/logs.yaml
  - ../../infra/iam/logs-irsa.yaml

patches:
  # 1. S3 Bucket: name, region, versioning, encryption, public block
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: logs-bucket
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: logs-bucket-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/versioning
        value: [{ enabled: true }]
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/serverSideEncryptionConfiguration
        value: [{ rule: { applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault: { sseAlgorithm: AES256 } } }]
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forProvider/publicAccessBlock
        value: [{ blockPublicAcls: true, blockPublicPolicy: true, ignorePublicAcls: true, restrictPublicBuckets: true }]

  # 2. IAM Role: OIDC trust policy (replace placeholders with real dev values)
  - target:
      kind: Role
      name: logs-irsa-role
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/assumeRolePolicyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"},
              "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
              "Condition": {
                "StringEquals": {"oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID/aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"},
                "StringLike": {"oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID/sub": "system:serviceaccount:logs-ns:*"}
              }
            }]
          }

  # 3. IAM Policy: S3 read/write scoped to dev bucket
  - target:
      kind: Policy
      name: logs-irsa-policy
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/policyDocument
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket", "s3:DeleteObject"],
              "Resource": [
                "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev",
                "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
              ]
            }]
          }
```

---

### 4. Prod Overlay Patches (`overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`)
*Same structure as dev, replace `dev` → `prod`, update region/AWS account/OIDC ID, and enforce prod least-privilege:*
- `bucket: myapp-logs-prod`
- `region: us-west-2` (or your prod region)
- OIDC issuer: `arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID`
- Policy `Action`: remove `s3:DeleteObject` if prod requires strict append-only audit trails.

---
